layer_3_action.subject: Carnotaurus
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Carnotaurus is standing in a playful, inquisitive pose in a sun-drenched clearing. It is slightly tilted in a 3/4 view to show its horns and bumpy skin. The background features sparse ferns and a bright, clear blue sky. Kicked-up dust particles surround its feet for grounding. No text.
